scenes.setting: Goosebumps and cold sweat: what interferes with the fog is no Sealed Artifact but the Primordial Demoness stirring inside her; Trissy offers pleasure in exchange for reporting her to the authorities, promises to draw off the pursuit, and wipes herself out of the carriage — leaving Klein trembling and certain he must act
scenes.text_anchor: The symbol of the apocalypse, the Primordial Demoness!

scenes.setting: Prepared like a Magician: split matches carry him out of the carriage and deep into the withered forest, where Azik's copper whistle summons the bone messenger with a one-word note — 'Help!' — a prayer-shaped report is pushed to Miss Justice, and then the sky fills with falling meteors
scenes.text_anchor: several meteors burning with raging flames falling from the sky

scenes.setting: The quill records it in the yellowing notebook: the Dallask meteor shower arrived two days early, and part of it just happened to land on the forest where Sherlock Moriarty was hiding. Yes, just happened

Mid-lesson, the report reaches Justice — a Demoness of Pleasure at the prince's side, renamed Cheek, the Primordial Demoness's true name — and Audrey's composure collapses; she ends the class and walks to her mother's living room with a plan and a weight on her shoulders
scenes.text_anchor: The true name of the Primordial Demoness… The Primordial Demoness!
